svg.title: Azure installation: the same backend, with Azure services around it
svg.text: Azure installation: the same backend, with Azure services around it
AKS with Blob, Key Vault, Entra ID, PostgreSQL flexible server and managed Prometheus. Kafka and Loki stay in the cluster.
AKS cluster (private API, 3 availability zones, zonal node pools) · environments/azure
ingesters: 3 zones, RF 3, WAL on PVC
WHAT CHANGES BETWEEN THE TWO INSTALLATIONS
any S3 API (Azure Blob for now)
Blob GZRS, private endpoint, Workload Identity, CMK
generated by the chart, kept on upgrade
Keycloak in the cluster (optionally brokering Entra ID)
Kafka, collectors, Loki, ruler, read gateway
